Frame count and mean permutation derivation
sources.details: Each 0.1-second, 16000-Hz segment has round(0.1*16000)=1600 samples. Concatenated N=3200; centered STFT pads 200 samples per side, giving floor((3200+400-400)/160)+1=21 frames. FFT has 201 one-sided bins, multiplied by 16 mel rows then transposed to [21,16]. For y_i=x_(20-i), (1/21)sum_i y_i=(1/21)sum_j x_j by j=20-i in real arithmetic. Floating reductions need not be bitwise equal; actual measured max mean difference is 9.5367431640625e-07 and satisfies |a-b|<=1e-8+1e-5|b| elementwise. Details preserved in a-derivation.
